notablePrerequisites:
You own all permanents you control.
You control zero permanents with shroud, protection from instants, or protection from white.
description:
During the end step prior to your turn, float at least {1}{W}{B}.
Cast Leave by paying {1}{W}, returning all permanents you control except Barren Glory from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast One with Nothing by paying {B}, discarding your hand.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.
